items.title: Keaton Mask → gate guard
items.hint: Borrow the fox mask from the Happy Mask Shop, then wear it for the guard at the Death Mountain Trail gate in Kakariko — he buys it for his son for 15 rupees.

items.title: Skull Mask → Skull Kid
items.hint: Borrow the skull mask and take it to the Skull Kid on the stump in the Lost Woods. He pays 10 rupees — less than the shop asks, so bring the difference.

items.title: Spooky Mask → graveyard boy
items.hint: Borrow the spooky mask and visit the boy in the graveyard during the day. He buys it for the full 30 rupees — the only buyer who pays sticker price.

items.title: Bunny Hood → Running Man
items.hint: Borrow the bunny hood and catch the Running Man on his laps around Hyrule Field. He pays as much as your wallet can hold — the payout that funds the rest of the game.

items.title: Mask of Truth (borrow)
items.hint: Finish the four sales and pay the shop back, and the shopkeeper lends you the Mask of Truth for free. Wear it to read what Gossip Stones are really thinking.

items.title: Goron Mask (borrow)
items.hint: After the trading quest, borrow the Goron Mask any time. It changes what some characters say to you.
